name: Daily Life Companion
description: Companion conversation pack for checking in on daily life, routine, and mood.
intro_line: I'd love to know how your day is going.

questions.text: What time did you wake up today?
How are you feeling right now?
How would you rate today so far?
questions.expected_context: a rating or descriptive assessment of the day

questions.text: What are you working on today?
Have you learned something new recently?
questions.expected_context: yes/no or a new fact or skill learned

questions.text: What are you grateful for today?
questions.expected_context: something the user is grateful for

questions.text: What is something you're looking forward to?

questions.expected_context: a plan or intention for tomorrow
